name: MsoGradientStyle
description: Specifies the style for a gradient fill.

constants.name: msoGradientHorizontal
constants.description: Gradient running horizontally across the shape.

constants.name: msoGradientVertical
constants.description: Gradient running vertically down the shape.

constants.name: msoGradientDiagonalUp
constants.description: Diagonal gradient moving from a bottom corner up to the opposite corner.

constants.name: msoGradientDiagonalDown
constants.description: Diagonal gradient moving from a top corner down to the opposite corner.

constants.name: msoGradientFromCorner
constants.description: Gradient running from a corner to the other three corners.

constants.name: msoGradientFromTitle
constants.description: Gradient running from the title outward.

constants.name: msoGradientFromCenter
constants.description: Gradient running from the center out to the corners.
